data.description:
## Problem

`.pi/test-config.json` defines the full suite as `npm --silent test -- tests/cli` + `npm --silent test -- tests/unit`. The `packages/herdr/src/*.test.ts` suite (~3.4k tests) is therefore **never** run by the dev-push gate, the ship release gate, or `implement.py finish`, even though herdr work items (e.g. WL-0MVEDM8OT007WDRS AC6/AC8) require it.

Child sessions work around this by running `npm --silent test -- packages/herdr/src` ad hoc, which bypasses the test skill's sanctioned runner and cache (so audits cannot see the evidence), and means a red herdr tree can be pushed to `dev` undetected. `run_tests.py --type herdr` fails with an unknown-type error because no local test extension or group defines it.

## Desired change

1. Add a `herdr` test type/group (`.pi/skills_extensions/test/extension.json` or a `groups.herdr` entry) mapped to `npm --silent test -- packages/herdr/src`, so `run_tests.py --type herdr --scope full` works and records a cache entry.
2. Decide whether the herdr suite also joins the full gate (cost ~12-19 min) or stays a separate gate invoked by items that touch it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `python3 run_tests.py --type herdr --json` runs the herdr package suite and records a cache entry.
- The dev-gate documentation states which suites the dev-push gate runs and how to run the herdr suite.
data.title: Configured test gate excludes the herdr package suite (no herdr test type/group)
